parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:
         
- true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including invalid AccessKey pairs, unauthorized Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and missing parameter values. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
- false: performs a dry run and sends the Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the authorization is verified.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: IsQueryEcsCount
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the capacity information of the security group. If you set this parameter to True, the `EcsCount` and `AvailableInstanceAmount` values in the response are valid.
> This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Settings this parameter indicates that the `MaxResults` and `NextToken` combination is used for paging.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the security group. Valid values:

- vpc: VPC.
- classic: classic network. The classic network is deprecated. For more information, see [Deprecation notice](~~2833134~~).

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paged query and paging operations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paged query and paging operations.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the security group belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000. You can invoke [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) to query resource groups.

> Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of security groups. You can specify up to 100 security group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,) in a JSON array format.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the security group.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the security group. Valid values:
- normal: basic security group.
- enterprise: advanced security group.

> If you do not specify this parameter, security groups of all types are queried.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description:
Specifies whether managed security group is managed. Valid values:

- true: Managed security group is managed.
- false: Managed security group is not managed.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the security group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count that have all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) to query resources.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the security group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the security group.

> For better compatibility, use the Tag.N.Key parameter.

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the security group.

> For better compatibility, use the Tag.N.Value parameter.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the security group belongs.
